narrative.overview: Finance is the owner's Stripe-inspired operational dashboard: cool neutral canvas, white work surfaces in light appearance, indigo actions and compact aligned rows. Its full-width workspace makes transaction review, category maintenance, bank health and saved reports directly usable. The Finance palette is scoped to the active Finance app shell and review dialogs; the other sections keep their existing paper-and-amber design.
keyCharacteristics: Compact workspace chrome and a persistent inner section navigation on wide desktops.
Tables, precise counts and explicit pagination for growing datasets.
Restrained surfaces and typography with visible action, selection and status states.

rules.name: The Scoped Palette Rule
rules.body: Apply these overrides only while Finance or a Finance review dialog is active. Finance does not replace the notes workspace's palette.

dos: Do use aligned rows, visible totals and explicit page controls for growing datasets.
Do keep category drill-down separate from named Edit and Delete actions, and confirm deletion with a replacement choice and a clear preservation statement.
Do keep loading, empty, no-match, failure and saved states actionable within the relevant panel.
donts: Don't restore the oversized category-tile grid or an unbounded sync-history feed.
Don't truncate the workbook to a fixed first-row or first-column preview; page through all data rows and contain wide sheets in their scroll region.
